explanation: American networks turned the show down, so British producer Lew Grade backed it. It was taped at Elstree Studios, north of London.

claims.text: The Muppet Show (1976 to 1981) was made in the United Kingdom, at Elstree Studios near London.
The Muppet Show was not made in the United States, Canada or Australia.
US television networks declined to pick up The Muppet Show as a series.
British producer Lew Grade's company backed The Muppet Show.

issues.note: 'Elstree Studios' today usually means the film studios on Shenley Road, Borehamwood; The Muppet Show was taped at ATV's own Elstree studios on Clarendon Road (now BBC Elstree). 'ATV's studios at Elstree' would avoid the mix-up. The key is unaffected.

claimResults.note: Counterintuitive because Henson was American; that is a plausible belief, not a misread word. 'Made' means taped in England with British backing.
